source: 外研社选必三 Unit 5 同主题完形(参观绿色高楼/像叶子的屋顶/会呼吸的学校/向鸟巢学习/家中小菜园/乡间周末)。用词限 U5/初中/常见词,选项同词性、答案唯一,与阅读听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: The Green Tower
passages.text: Last summer my class visited a tall green (1)____ in the city centre. From far away it looked like a giant tree made of glass and steel. Our guide told us that the (2)____ had studied real forests before drawing his plans. Living plants grew on every floor, so the air inside felt fresh and (3)____. The walls were covered with small panels that could (4)____ sunlight into clean electricity. I was (5)____ to learn that the building used almost no power from outside. On the roof there was a quiet (6)____ where birds came to drink. Our guide said that good design should (7)____ from nature instead of fighting against it. At the end of the visit, each of us tried to (8)____ a simple model of a green house. Mine was far from perfect, but making it helped me (9)____ how hard an architect's job really is. I left the tower feeling that nature and the city could live in (10)____ after all.

questions.explanation: a tall green tower 与下文 the tower 呼应。
drawing his plans 说明是建筑师。
fresh and clean 搭配,描述空气。
turn sunlight into electricity 把阳光转化为电。
得知建筑几乎不用外来电力,作者感到惊讶。
鸟来喝水的地方是池塘。
learn from nature 向自然学习。
build a model 制作模型。
helped me understand 帮我理解。
live in harmony 和谐共处。

passages.title: A Roof Like a Leaf
passages.text: An engineer once spent a whole month watching how a large (1)____ collected rain and let it run off gently. She noticed that its surface was not flat but slightly (2)____, so the water never stayed too long. This simple idea gave her a clever (3)____ for a new kind of roof. Working with a small team, she began to (4)____ a roof that copied the shape of the leaf. The team had to (5)____ many models before they found one that worked. Their goal was to (6)____ rainwater and send it down into a tank below. When heavy rain came, the new roof stayed dry and (7)____, just like the leaf. People who saw it were (8)____ by how natural it looked. The engineer later said that nature had been her best (9)____ all along. Now several schools have asked her to (10)____ the same kind of roof for them.

questions.explanation: 下文 like the leaf 指明是叶子。
slightly curved 表面略微弯曲,使水不停留。
a clever idea 一个聪明的想法。
design a roof 设计屋顶。
test many models 测试很多模型。
collect rainwater 收集雨水。
stayed dry and strong 又干又结实。
amazed by 对其自然外观感到惊叹。
nature had been her best teacher 自然是她最好的老师。
build the same roof 为学校建造同样的屋顶。

passages.title: The School That Breathes
passages.text: Our new school looks quite different from any other in the town. Its walls are covered with green (1)____ that grow all year round. In summer, the leaves give cool (2)____, so the classrooms never become too hot. In winter, sunlight passes through the bare branches and (3)____ the rooms naturally. The architect who designed it wanted us to (4)____ in harmony with nature every day. Instead of using a lot of (5)____, the building makes much of its own from the sun. Rain that falls on the roof is not (6)____; it is stored and used to water the plants. Even the air feels (7)____ because so many leaves clean it. Some visitors find it hard to (8)____ that a school can work this way. But our teachers say the design has helped us (9)____ that people and plants belong together. Studying here has changed the way I (10)____ about the future of our cities.

questions.explanation: green plants 绿色植物,与 leaves/branches 呼应。
cool shade 凉爽的树荫。
冬日阳光自然地温暖房间。
live in harmony with nature 与自然和谐相处。
下文 makes much of its own from the sun 指电力/能源。
雨水没有被浪费,而是被储存使用。
叶子净化空气,空气清新。
hard to believe 难以相信。
helped us see that 帮我们认识到。
the way I think about the future 我对未来的看法。

passages.title: Lessons from a Bird's Nest
passages.text: A young designer named Lin loved to watch birds build their (1)____ in the trees near her home. She was amazed by how strong and light they were, even though birds use only grass and (2)____. One spring she decided to (3)____ how the tiny builders worked. For weeks she sat quietly and made careful (4)____ of every step. She learned that a good nest must (5)____ both wind and rain without breaking. This wild wisdom gave her the (6)____ to design a new kind of light roof for camps. Her first model was too weak, so she had to (7)____ it again and again. In the end her design proved both cheap and (8)____. Lin often says that the birds were her real (9)____. Thanks to them, she now helps families build homes that can (10)____ strong winds far better than before.

questions.explanation: birds build their nests 鸟筑巢。
grass and mud 草和泥,鸟筑巢的材料。
study how the builders worked 研究小工匠如何工作。
made careful notes 做了仔细的记录。
face both wind and rain 经受风雨。
the idea to design 设计的灵感/想法。
test it again and again 一次次测试。
cheap and strong 又便宜又结实。
the birds were her real teachers 鸟是她真正的老师。
homes that can resist strong winds 能抵御大风的房屋。

passages.title: A Little Garden at Home
passages.text: Last year my grandmother taught me to grow vegetables in our small (1)____ behind the house. At first I had no idea how to (2)____ the seeds, so she showed me where each one should go. She told me that a good gardener must learn to (3)____ and never rush nature. Some mornings I felt (4)____ because nothing seemed to be growing at all. But slowly, tiny green leaves began to (5)____ through the dark soil. Grandmother said that watching them was her favourite (6)____ of the day. We gave the plants water, sunlight and plenty of (7)____. By the end of summer our garden was full of (8)____ vegetables. I was proud that my own hands had (9)____ them. From that little garden I learned that good things take time, and that patience can (10)____ a real reward.

questions.explanation: grow vegetables in our small garden 在小菜园里种菜。
plant the seeds 播种。
learn to wait 学会等待,不催促自然。
什么都没长,作者感到担心。
leaves began to push through the soil 嫩芽顶出泥土。
her favourite part of the day 一天中最喜欢的时刻。
plenty of care 充足的照料。
fresh vegetables 新鲜的蔬菜。
my own hands had grown them 亲手种出。
patience can bring a reward 耐心能带来回报。

passages.title: A Weekend in the Country
passages.text: Last weekend I stayed in a small (1)____ deep in the countryside, far from the noisy town. There was no traffic, only the soft (2)____ of birds in the morning. The owner, an old farmer, lived there in great (3)____, with a garden, a few chickens and an old dog. He told me that he had once worked in a big city but had chosen to (4)____ from that busy life. Every evening he liked to (5)____ on the doorstep and watch the sun go down behind the hills. At first the deep silence made me feel a little (6)____, but soon I began to enjoy it. The fresh air and slow days helped me (7)____ all my worries. I understood why so many writers have loved this kind of (8)____ life. On Sunday I was almost (9)____ to leave such a peaceful place. The short stay taught me that quietness can be a real (10)____.

questions.explanation: a small cottage 乡间小屋。
the soft songs of birds 鸟儿轻柔的歌声。
lived there in great ease 过着十分悠闲的生活。
withdraw from that busy life 退出忙碌的生活。
sit on the doorstep 坐在门口台阶上。
深深的寂静起初让人有点孤独。
helped me forget all my worries 帮我忘却烦恼。
this kind of simple life 这种简单的生活。
almost sorry to leave 几乎舍不得离开。
quietness can be a real gift 宁静是一份真正的礼物。
